# GhostPaw

> Seven small MIT-licensed Node.js libraries for agent state, published under the @ghostpaw scope on npm. Each stores its data in SQLite through the built-in node:sqlite module, needs Node.js 24 or newer, and has zero runtime dependencies.

Install any of them with `npm install @ghostpaw/<name>`. Source: https://github.com/GhostPawJS

## Pages

- [GhostPaw home](https://ghostpaw.dev/): what each of the seven libraries gives an agent that runs on its own, how they fit together, and measured tests, bundle size and import time.
- [codex, agent memory](https://codex.ghostpaw.dev/): beliefs with a source, a certainty and a revision history; correct or delete a wrong fact.
- [questlog, agent tasks](https://questlog.ghostpaw.dev/): quests that only finish with a written outcome; the run_quest tool refuses a blocked quest unless force is true.
- [affinity, agent contacts](https://affinity.ghostpaw.dev/): a social CRM for agents; contacts, promises, a drift radar and yearly dates, replayed from a real run.
- [souls, agent identity](https://souls.ghostpaw.dev/): an agent's prompt as an essence plus evidence-backed traits; a refinement waits until evidence from more than one source agrees.
- [grimoire, agent skills](https://grimoire.ghostpaw.dev/): SKILL.md folders whose improvements are sealed as git commits, with notes in SQLite and rollback.
- [email, agent email](https://email.ghostpaw.dev/): IMAP and SMTP in-process with a SQLite cache, threads and FTS5 search; reading and sending are separate tools.
- [telegram, agent Telegram bots](https://telegram.ghostpaw.dev/): every update mirrored into SQLite before the handler, with edit history, reply chains and plan-first agent tools.

## Libraries

- [@ghostpaw/codex](https://github.com/GhostPawJS/codex) 0.3.2: agent memory as beliefs with source, certainty and history; computed flags for stale, fading and low-trust beliefs. Ships an MCP server and a ghostpaw-codex command line tool.
- [@ghostpaw/questlog](https://github.com/GhostPawJS/questlog) 0.6.2: tasks, deadlines, scheduled windows and RRULE repeats as quests; finishing needs an outcome; state is derived at read time.
- [@ghostpaw/affinity](https://github.com/GhostPawJS/affinity) 0.3.0: contacts with identities, relationship tracks, an evidence journal and yearly dates.
- [@ghostpaw/souls](https://github.com/GhostPawJS/souls) 0.3.0: an agent's character as an essence plus evidence-backed traits, with gated refinement, level-up and rollback.
- [@ghostpaw/grimoire](https://github.com/GhostPawJS/grimoire) 0.3.0: learned procedures as SKILL.md files, git-versioned, with evidence notes and a health check.
- [@ghostpaw/email](https://github.com/GhostPawJS/email) 0.4.1: IMAP sync and SMTP send with a local SQLite cache, threading and FTS5 search, split into five agent tools. Ships an email command line tool.
- [@ghostpaw/telegram](https://github.com/GhostPawJS/telegram) 0.6.2: a Telegram bot channel that mirrors every update into SQLite, with edit history, FTS5 search and agent tools that return plans by default.
